components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Initiates a primary review or save action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); color: #fff; border: 0; padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font: 500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent, #4c8dff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Supports secondary actions without competing with the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3038); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font: 500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, background 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border-color: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact technical input for organizations, projects, and review settings.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; background: var(--bg, #0d1117); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3038); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); padding: 6px 8px; font: 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: var(--text-faint, #6e7681); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: 1px; border-color: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); }

components.name: View Navigation
components.description: Stable segmented navigation between pull requests and rollouts.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 2px; background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3038); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); } .ds-nav-item { background: transparent; color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); border: 0; padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 4px; font: 500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-item:hover { color: var(--text, #e6edf3); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); color: #fff; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Pairs a semantic dot and text label with a full border.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3038); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); font: 600 11px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-status.ds-success { color: var(--add-line, #2ea043); border-color: var(--add-line, #2ea043); }

components.name: Pull Request Card
components.description: A scan-first summary that keeps title, state, branch, author, and age in one compact unit.
components.html:
Improve rollout failure visibility
#1842feature/statusby Ada12m ago
components.css: .ds-pr-card { width: min(560px, 100%); background: var(--bg-elev, #161b22); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border: 1px solid var(--border-soft, #21262d); border-radius: var(--radius, 10px); padding: 12px 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-pr-card:hover { background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); border-color: var(--accent-dim, #1f6feb); } .ds-pr-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-pr-title { margin-bottom: 6px; font: 500 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pr-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px 12px; color: var(--text-faint, #6e7681); font: 12px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pr-meta code { padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); } .ds-pr-id { color: var(--accent, #4c8dff); }

components.description: Progressively reveals review status, summary, and staged findings without leaving the PR.

Findings appear inline beside the changed evidence.
components.css: .ds-review { overflow: hidden; background: var(--bg-elev2, #1c2230); color: var(--text, #e6edf3); border: 1px solid var(--add-line, #2ea043); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); font: 13px/1.5 -apple-system, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-review-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-review-head:hover { background: var(--bg-elev, #161b22); } .ds-review-head:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #4c8dff); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-review-head strong { color: var(--add-line, #2ea043); font-weight: 600; } .ds-review-summary { color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); } .ds-review-body { padding: 8px 12px 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #2a3038); color: var(--text-dim, #9aa5b1); }

narrative.overview: ADO PR Ops is a compact engineering workbench built for sustained attention. Midnight Workbench neutrals reduce glare and separate hierarchy through tonal layers, while Azure Signal blue marks the current view, selected evidence, and actions that move work forward. The system is focused, trustworthy, and efficient. It favors familiar controls, explicit state, progressive disclosure, and dense but readable information. It rejects noisy monitoring dashboards packed with decorative widgets, competing colors, and weak hierarchy.
keyCharacteristics: Compact spacing with stable alignment and clear grouping.
Semantic color is reserved for state and risk.
Progressive detail preserves list and review context.
Motion is brief and communicates state changes only.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Azure Signal and semantic colors identify actions, selection, risk, or state; they are never decorative background color.

rules.name: The Layer Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use Midnight Canvas, Workbench Surface, and Raised Graphite to establish hierarchy before adding elevation.

rules.name: The Technical Identity Rule
rules.body: Monospace communicates exact values, not atmosphere; never use it for ordinary navigation or explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Compact Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Create emphasis with weight, color, and grouping before increasing type size.

rules.name: The Earned Elevation Rule
rules.body: A shadow means the surface has left document flow or temporarily owns focus; static list content stays border-and-tone based.

dos: Do use Azure Signal (#4c8dff) and Azure Action (#1f6feb) for current selection, primary actions, and actionable links.
Do establish hierarchy with the three neutral layers before adding a shadow.
Do pair success, warning, and danger color with text, an icon, or an explicit label.
Do keep review evidence near its source line and preserve the user's list, filter, and scroll context.
Do use visible keyboard focus, semantic labels, readable contrast, and reduced-motion alternatives.
Do keep most state transitions between 120ms and 260ms and limit them to feedback or spatial continuity.
donts: Don't build a noisy monitoring dashboard packed with decorative widgets, competing colors, and weak hierarchy.
Don't turn review metadata into a wall of equal-weight badges; title, risk, evidence, and next action come first.
Don't use Azure Signal or semantic colors as decoration on inactive surfaces.
Don't use a colored border-left or border-right thicker than 1px as a card, callout, or status accent; use a full border, dot, icon, or tinted surface.
Don't introduce glass effects, gradient text, decorative motion, or oversized product typography.
Don't use faint text for essential labels, placeholder instructions, or actionable content.
